test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT correct with respect to amendments in the Constitution of India ?

options.text: 72ⁿd amendment - to make provisions for setting up Rent Control Tribunals
101st amendment - to introduce goods and service tax
61st amendment - to reduce the voting age from 21 to 18 years
102ⁿd amendment - to give constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes

solution:
The correct answer is __**72nd amendment - to make provisions for setting up Rent Control Tribunals**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **72nd amendment** of the Constitution of India was related to the reservation of seats for Scheduled Tribes in the Legislative Assemblies of the States of Tripura, Meghalaya, Mizoram, and Nagaland.
 
• The **101st amendment** introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India.
 
• The **61st amendment** reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years.
 
• The **102nd amendment** gave constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Constitution of India** was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and **came into effect on 26th January 1950**.
 
• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written** constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Union List has been amended several times to meet the evolving needs of the nation.
